LEGENDS ON THE LINKS

Los Angeles • November 1-2, 2026

Sunday, November 1

Event Overview

Legends on the Links brings together athletes, business leaders, celebrities, and supporters for an unforgettable two-day experience in Los Angeles. This signature annual fundraiser blends world-class golf, premium hospitality, networking, entertainment, and philanthropy.

Guests will enjoy:


  • Exclusive VIP Welcome Reception
  • Celebrity athlete captains
  • Tournament play at Riviera Country Club
  • Live & silent auction experiences
  • Premium food & beverage
  • Post Golf Awards Reception
  • High-level networking opportunities


All proceeds benefit the Rod Dedeaux Foundation and its mission to create opportunities for underserved youth.

About the Rod Dedeaux Foundation

The Rod Dedeaux Foundation impacts every step of a ballplayer’s journey — from the dugout to the final out.


The foundation partners with transformative organizations to create equal opportunities for at-risk youth to excel:


  • On the diamond
  • In the classroom
  • In the game of life


Core Impact Initiatives


  • Over $400,000+ awarded in scholarships
  • Partnership with MLB Compton Youth Academy
  • Baseball, softball, and tee-ball clinics
  • Equipment, coaching, and facility access
  • Youth league growth in Compton schools
  • Safe spaces and mentorship programs


Growing the Future


New youth baseball and softball initiatives are projected to serve:

﻿

  • 500 students in first summer launch
  • 1,000 students in fall programming
  • 2,000 youth in 2026
  • 3,000 youth by 2027+


The Riviera Country Club

One of the most prestigious golf clubs in the world, The Riviera Country Club has hosted generations of legendary players and iconic tournaments.


Course Highlights


  • Founded in 1926
  • Opened in 1927
  • Designed by George C. Thomas
  • Ranked among top golf courses worldwide
  • Host of The Genesis Open
  • Future site of the 2028 Olympic golf competitions


A timeless championship setting for an unforgettable event.

THE RIVIERA COUNTRY CLUB
Pacific Palisades, CA

The Riviera Country Club is one of the most storied and internationally revered clubs on earth. Since its inception in 1927, Riviera has been a fixture in tournament golf, serving as the annual venue for the Genesis Invitational along with the closing event of the PGA Tour’s West Coast swing. "Hogan's Alley", as Riviera is known, is an architectural masterpiece that highlights the Golden Age of golf course architecture and pays respect to the ambiance and roots of the game.


"I consider it (Riviera) one of the greatest tests of golf."

 ~ Arnold Palmer

LOCATION
1250 Capri Drive

Pacific Palisades, CA 90272
